card.name: Digits inside numbers, mid-figure
card.fires_on: Digits, decimal points and thousands commas partway through a number, usually right after the first digit or two. It appears in doses, lab cutoffs, counts, scripture references and strain names.

modes.label: Digit after leading digit
modes.description: A digit that continues a multi-digit number, such as 1 in 169 or 6 in 16.0.
modes.example: ranking 138 out of <<1>>69 countries and territories listed.

modes.label: Decimal point or comma
modes.description: A decimal point or thousands comma inside a figure, often in lab limits or dose amounts.

modes.label: Single digit start of reference
modes.description: A lone digit that begins a reference or measurement, such as a chapter number or strain number.

card.writes: It suppresses time-like endings such as pm, am and th, so it steers the next piece away from time or ordinal suffixes and toward more number text.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a number, on a digit, decimal point or comma, when more of the number is still to come.
